email.body1:
Claudette, saw EarthCam rolled out visual AI that tracks materials and safety, plus the new AI robotic camera for indoor jobsites.

Launching new AI products usually opens more contractor and jobsite accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EarthCam off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Claudette, quick follow-up for EarthCam.

When new AI capabilities ship, the accounts worth chasing pile up faster than a team can work them, and most groups don't know exactly how many meetings it takes to hit target. The gap shows up late, then the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings EarthCam needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Claudette, last bit of proof for EarthCam.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EarthCam's reply rate likely compares to other B2B tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to EarthCam either way.
